purpose: Qualitative demand/friction intelligence for the single Stödassistenten learning system. Scores are prioritization signals, not measured search volumes and not proof of eligibility, amount, deadlines or application outcome. Forum phrasing is discovery-only; student-finance facts require current CSN primary-source verification.

scoring.priority_rule: Prioritize combinations of high demand, high friction, high consequence and weak current product coverage. Scores are qualitative prioritization, not measured search volumes.

räknas deltidsstudier som lika många CSN-veckor
jag fick inget sommarjobb kan jag läsa sommarkurs och få CSN
får jag CSN hela sommaren om jag kommer in på en sommarkurs

إذا درست دورة صيفية هل أحصل على CSN تلقائيا طوال الصيف
چند هفته CSN برایم باقی مانده و آیا دوره تابستانی از آن کم می‌کند

demand_signal.basis: Questions about remaining study-finance weeks, part-time conversion and summer financing recur naturally among students planning further study or replacing missing summer work. This is qualitative discovery, not measured search volume.

friction_signal.basis: The user must combine education level, study pace, used/remaining weeks, summer-course eligibility, registration and sometimes half-year income effects. A generic student path that asks broad money/children/health/housing questions does not resolve the route-changing student-finance facts efficiently.

miss_consequence.basis: Incorrect assumptions can lead a student to plan studies around weeks they do not have, misunderstand part-time use, or expect summer financing before the course and registration conditions are met.

source_fragmentation.basis: CSN separates general week limits, personal remaining weeks on Mina sidor, summer-study conditions, study pace and income/fribelopp guidance across several official pages and logged-in information.

language_accessibility_friction.basis: Terms such as studiemedel, använda veckor, studietakt, sammanhängande veckor and fribelopp are easy to conflate, especially when the user starts from a practical problem such as no summer job rather than from a benefit name.

steps_to_action.basis: A safe route should identify education level and planned pace/period, then send the user to current CSN guidance and Mina sidor for personal week balance instead of collecting or guessing account details.

recurrence_signal.basis: The same misunderstandings recur around whether 240 weeks applies to everyone, how part-time study consumes weeks, whether a summer course automatically means CSN, and where remaining weeks are actually shown.

current_product_coverage_gap.basis: The source registry already contains CSN and the public product can retain actor_type=student, but there is no normalized CSN week/summer support record, no permanent CSN week regression, and no focused public student-finance handoff. The current general person flow can ask broad work, money, children, health and housing questions before the education-level/study-pace facts that change this route.

signals.recommended_learning_action: Keep one person product and one truth layer. Add CSN remaining-week and summer-study cases to the canonical scenario system, normalize the current CSN facts as NEEDS_REVIEW, and later add a same-shell student-finance focus route that asks only education level and planned study pace/period before sending personal week-balance checks to Mina sidor. Do not create a student app or infer personal week balance from the public story.
signals.truth_rule: Forum language and qualitative scores are discovery signals, never truth. Verify week limits, summer-study conditions, study-pace effects and any income/fribelopp claim against current CSN primary sources. Personal remaining weeks must come from the user's current CSN account information, not from a prior AI answer, raw feedback or public eval data.
